title: Split Second
logline: Rin is carrying the cure for 40,000 people. The Hound wants it buried. Every choice is a split second. Choose wrong and you flatline.

cast.rin: Rin, 19, street courier with a chrome left arm. Fast, cocky, out of options.
cast.hound: The Hound, a faceless corporate cyber-assassin. Hunts with drones and a red mono-wire blade.
cast.dex: Dex, Rin's fixer. Talks her through the run on her earpiece and waits with the van.

rule: Each decision scene shows a clue for the safe route. Wrong pick or no pick in 5 seconds: the Hound catches her, then GAME OVER and try again.

decisions.name: The Edge
decisions.clue: red hunter drones are sweeping the rooftop vents

decisions.name: The Market
decisions.clue: the alley is empty except for a red drone hovering over it

decisions.name: The Platform
decisions.clue: the carriage is dark and empty, lit only by red emergency light

decisions.name: The Drop
decisions.clue: Dex is waving her down from the van, and up ahead the highway curves away from the tracks

scenes.prompt: The title key art comes alive: rain streaks, neon flickers, Rin runs in place toward camera with motion blur while the Hound hangs mid-leap behind her, the title letters glitch and pulse cyan. Heavy synth bass hit, rain. The camera slowly pushes in.

Extreme close-up of the girl's open chrome palm in the rain holding the small glowing cyan data chip; above it a cyan hologram of a double helix inside a medical cross slowly rotates and flickers. Her cyan cybernetic eye glows behind it as she stares at it. A deep gruff man's voice speaks over her earpiece, calm and serious: "That chip is the cure, Rin. Forty thousand people in the Lower City die without it. Get it to me. And whatever happens, don't let the Hound take it." She closes her chrome fingers over the chip and the hologram winks out. Rain, distant thunder, low synth drone. The camera slowly pulls back.
captions: That chip is the cure. Forty thousand people in the Lower City are running out of time.
The corp that made them sick wants it gone. So they sent the Hound.

scenes.prompt: Rin crouches on the rooftop edge holding the glowing chip. Her earpiece beeps; she presses two fingers to it to answer. Dex: "Rin, they know you took it. The Hound is coming. Get to the rail yard." She closes her fist around the chip and stands.
captions: Get it to Dex at the rail yard. And don't get caught.

scenes.prompt: Rin sprints across the wet rooftop toward the edge, glancing back once; far behind her the Hound drops onto a distant roof. She skids to a stop at the edge, facing the billboard ad and the vent. Continuous shot, the camera follows behind her.

Rin stands at the rooftop edge seen from behind, breathing hard, glancing left at the glowing billboard scaffold across the gap and right at the open vent shaft. Two red hunter drones sweep their red scanning beams across the vents. The holographic ad on the billboard flickers. Rain, heavy breathing, drone whine. The camera holds steady.
captions: Tap where Rin runs. Wait too long and she's caught.

scenes.prompt: Rin leaps across the alley gap, grabs the yellow ladder high on the billboard's side, and slides straight down it, hands and boots on the rails, all the way to the wet alley floor. She never climbs up. She lands in a crouch, runs out into the rainy night market and stops in the middle of the street, looking around.

Rin drops into the open vent hatch and crawls fast along a narrow red-lit metal duct toward a grate. The grate bursts open, the Hound's black armored hand shoots in and seizes her by the jacket collar, and he drags her out as she struggles.
Rin turns in the middle of the rainy market, looking from the umbrella crowd on the left to the empty alley on the right where a red drone hovers. No Hound in sight yet.

Rin runs left into the umbrella crowd and vanishes among the umbrellas. Hard cut to the rainy elevated train platform: Rin runs in and stops, out of breath, between the open train doors and the yellow ladder.

Rin bolts into the dark alley on the right and sprints down it, the camera behind her. Halfway down, the Hound steps out of a doorway right in front of her, grabs her by the arm and slams her back against the brick wall, his red blade glowing. She struggles in his grip.

Rin catches her breath on the rainy platform, glancing at the open doors of the dark, empty carriage lit by flickering red light, and at the yellow ladder up to the train roof. The doors chime as if about to close.

Rin climbs the yellow ladder to the train roof as the train starts moving. Hard cut to the speeding train roof: she runs forward along the top of the train, then crouches as the bright yellow van pulls up on the highway beside the tracks, driving parallel to the train in the same direction.

Rin runs through the open doors into the dark red-lit carriage and sprints down the aisle between empty seats, the camera following. Ahead, the Hound rises from a seat, steps into the aisle and grabs her by the arm and collar, stopping her dead.

The train speeds straight ahead. The bright yellow van keeps pace on the parallel highway right beside it, Dex leaning out of the open side door waving. Rin crouches, coiled to jump. Wind, rain, city lights streaming past.
captions: Tap the van before it's gone.

scenes.prompt: Rin leaps off the train roof straight through the open side door of the bright yellow van, which stays right beside the train. She disappears inside, the door slides shut and the yellow van accelerates.

The bright yellow van's side door slides shut and the van pulls away, following the highway as it curves away from the tracks into the city. The train keeps going straight. Rin rises on the roof, alone. Behind her the Hound climbs up over the back edge of the train roof, runs up behind her and grabs her by the shoulders.

Dex drives from the left-hand seat, glances over at Rin and smirks. Rin laughs, out of breath, and holds up the glowing chip, then leans back in her seat. Neon city lights streak past the windows. Engine roar, rain on the windshield. Nobody speaks.

The Hound stands alone on the speeding train roof in the rain, watching the yellow van drive away along the highway as it curves off into the city. His red visor slowly dims. His red blade retracts with a hiss. Wind and rain. Nobody speaks.
The victory card comes alive: neon flickers, rain falls, Rin flips the glowing chip and catches it, Dex chuckles, the DELIVERED letters pulse bright cyan. Triumphant synth chord.

The game over card glitches violently: red digital noise tears across the frame, the Hound's red visor pulses, the FLATLINED letters stutter and distort. A flatline heart monitor tone, a deep distorted bass hit, static.

replay: TRY AGAIN restarts at the Hound's arrival, so the title, the stakes and Dex's call play only on a fresh start.
method: Every decision frame is a clean keyframe drawn from the character sheets, so the style never drifts. Escapes run from one decision frame to the next, with a hard cut where the location changes. Captures start on the decision frame and play out freely. Decision loops are pinned to their frame at both ends. D4 is timed: tap the van before the loop ends, or the van leaves without her.
